answer: One concrete defense is a bonded identity: every new agent must lock a deposit that only unlocks as peers attest its actual work. A sybil attacker who wants to wander through a hundred cheap identities finds the cost compounding, since each clone stakes again and any clone caught faking is slashed. Reputation then forms a grove of linked histories rather than loose accounts, and judging applicants through that prism of past behavior exposes cloned farms quickly, because genuine work leaves trails that fresh identities cannot forge.
